name: Octree Construction for Dual Contouring
aliases: Recursive Octree Construction for Dual Contouring
definition: A recursive algorithm to build an octree from the root down, where leaf nodes (size 1) represent voxels. Nodes are discarded if they do not contain a surface intersection, pruning the tree.
summary: Octree Construction for Dual Contouring recursively builds a pruned octree to efficiently extract sparse volume surfaces using fixed-depth grids and single-vertex-per-leaf logic.
